messages:
anya: Quick sync webinar on May 10 10am PT. Need final X thread + 2 LinkedIn posts, hero GIF, LP with UTMs, and SDR routing by EOD tomorrow. Who takes what?
kai: Ill write the X thread + one short stand-alone post. Will tag variants [dev]/[enterprise]. Need GIF + LP link to add UTMs. ETA noon.
rachel: Design will export GIF + static image. Ill provide 1MB X-safe GIF and 1200x675 MP4 for LinkedIn. Uploading to /design-assets by 4pm.
anya: We want two headline tones: explicit numbers for benchmarks and a benefit-forward variant. Kai please prep both.
kai: Drafting: (A) "2-3x lower inference latency in production" (B) "Serve faster, cut inference costs". Including UTMs and alt text.
legal: Please add the benchmark workbook & prompt. We need baseline config to approve numeric claims. 48h review after materials posted.
rachel: Assets uploaded: https://redwood-assets/webinar/may10. Files: hero_chart_1mb.gif, hero_static_1200x675.jpg. Alt text added.
sdr-ops: Routing rules draft ready: company_size>150 -> AE queue; 20-150 -> SDR rotation; <20 -> nurture. Flag watch_time>50% as MQL. Will map fields once webhook path is live.
anya: @devops (pinged outside thread) please create webhook path and add secret to vault so Zapier->SFDC mapping can be wired.
kai: Copy in scheduler doc with UTMs: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=may10_webinar&utm_content=variantA. I'll also prepare a follow tweet with recording CTA.
rachel: Compressed GIF <1MB for X and MP4 uploaded for LinkedIn. PNG fallback included.
legal: I'll start review once the spreadsheet includes workload traces and metric definitions.
anya: Final checklist: copy in scheduler, assets in design-assets, LP live + UTM, webhook + secret, SDR routing doc. React with :white_check_mark: when your piece is done.
kai: 705
rachel: 705

legal: aiming to clear by EOD tomorrow if docs are complete.
anya: Thanks all Ill run the scheduler tomorrow AM and post final times here. If anything blocks, drop it in this thread. :thumbsup:
